cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, or $0.148 per request, versus $0.016 across all 204,993 requests. It accounts for 5.2% of weekly spend while generating 0.6% of requests; review its model selection and request characteristics.

cards.title: Low-cache callers handle 44,955 requests
cards.detail: The 12 callers with cache-hit rates from 0% to 8.9% generated 44,955 requests and had a weighted 6.6% cache-hit rate. The remaining 160,038 requests had a weighted 86.7% cache-hit rate, indicating a substantial cache configuration or workload-pattern gap.
